about_app.title: About This Program
about_app.subtitle: An all-in-one desktop solution that solves the structural defects of Google Photos Takeout, delivering lossless metadata restoration and intelligent media organization.
about_app.sec_takeout_title: 4 Structural Flaws of Google Takeout & Solutions
about_app.takeout_1_desc: Google Photos strips capture timestamps, GPS coordinates, and descriptions into external .json files upon export, leaving the media files themselves stripped of essential metadata.
about_app.takeout_2_desc: Extracting archives stamps all files with 'download date (today)'. When viewed in galleries or NAS storage, 10-year-old photos appear as taken today, completely destroying chronological order.
about_app.takeout_3_desc: Takeout cuts long filenames around 47–51 characters. When duplicates exist, it produces irregular naming pairs such as 'Photo(1).jpg' alongside 'Photo.jpg(1).json'.
about_app.takeout_4_desc: When a photo belongs to multiple albums, Takeout duplicates the physical file into each folder, multiplying archive sizes and consuming massive disk space.
about_app.engine_step_1_desc: Locates JSON sidecar files with identical basenames first.
about_app.engine_step_2_desc: Normalizes irregular parenthesized duplicate numbering patterns for cross-matching.
about_app.engine_step_3_desc: Reverse-engineers prefixes and extensions of truncated JSON files cut at 47-51 chars.
about_app.engine_step_4_desc: Inherits original metadata for filtered, edited, or rotated Google Photos exports.
about_app.engine_step_5_desc: Compares remaining embedded header timestamps against JSON photoTakenTime when names diverge.
about_app.engine_step_5_example: Final sole-candidate match within ±60 seconds tolerance in identical directory

about_app.geo_1_desc: Coordinates of 170k+ cities with pop. > 1,000 (GeoNames) packed into a 5.37MB binary in memory. Resolves nearest places in 0.05ms (0.00005s) per photo without internet.
about_app.geo_2_desc: Standardizes places into 'Country ➔ State/Province ➔ City'. Allows seamless drill-down exploration in treemaps and library searches.
about_app.geo_3_desc: Prioritizes worldwide famous landmarks and travel hubs, delivering intuitive place names matching actual user travel experiences.
about_app.rename_1_desc: Combine rich metadata tokens such as capture date/time, camera make/model, and country/city location to build custom file names effortlessly.
about_app.rename_2_desc: Customize separators (underscore, hyphen), case transformation, and bracket styles while verifying results instantly in a live preview table.
about_app.rename_3_desc: Pre-detects name collisions and appends auto-sequences before disk writes, guaranteeing lossless media name updates.
about_app.reorg_1_desc: Offers 10 storage layouts tailored to your needs, including Year/Month, Year/Month/Day, Camera/Year/Month, and Location combinations.
about_app.reorg_2_title: In-Place Fast Moves & New Target Locations
about_app.reorg_2_desc: Supports instant in-place directory reorganizations on the same drive as well as clean transfers to external drives or new target paths.
about_app.reorg_3_title: Automatic Empty Folder Cleanup & Safe Moves
about_app.reorg_3_desc: Automatically prunes empty directories post-move. High-speed file system pointer moves organize tens of thousands of files in seconds.
about_app.tools_1_desc: Compare 11 key fields side-by-side (capture date, GPS, camera, lens) with real-time binary parsing of raw EXIF and QuickTime movie headers.
about_app.tools_2_desc: Visually explore and drill down disk consumption across dates, camera models, geographic locations, and folder hierarchies.
about_app.tools_3_title: Asynchronous Lazy Loading & SQLite Local Index
about_app.tools_3_desc: Smoothly navigate large media libraries with QThreadPool multi-threaded lazy loading and perform instant full-text searches with SQLite3 FTS5.
about_app.i18n_1_desc: Full support for English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese (TW/HK) with immediate live UI updates without restarts.
about_app.i18n_2_desc: Automatically detects host OS language and pairs optimal UI and geocoding language preferences seamlessly.
about_app.i18n_3_desc: Includes intelligent sleep-prevention wakelock during long operations, native clipboard integration, and file manager reveals.
about_app.sec_safety_title: Safety Principles & Data Integrity (Zero Data Loss)
about_app.safety_1_desc: Operates fully offline without internet connection. Zero personal photos or location bytes ever leave your machine.
about_app.safety_2_desc: Safely injects metadata chunks at the binary level without recompressing or re-encoding media, preserving 100% original quality.
about_app.safety_3_desc: Compares file hashes to skip redundant duplicates across folders, assigning sequence numbers to distinct files to prevent data loss.
